scope: Read-only bytecode, ABI, source and metadata compatibility audit; runtime verification is recorded separately.

source_and_bytecode_findings.BackpackMenu: Only constructor slot coordinates move +1 X and -1 Y. Slot index/order/count, container storage, quick-move, close persistence and validity methods remain unchanged.
source_and_bytecode_findings.BackpackScreen: Uses pieces of vanilla generic_54.png instead of the removed custom backpack GUI sprite; label/slot/background offsets adjust accordingly. No public signature changes.
source_and_bytecode_findings.network: All network package classes and payload codecs are byte-identical.
source_and_bytecode_findings.registries: Item, menu and recipe registration classes are byte-identical.
source_and_bytecode_findings.data_components: Component types and codecs are byte-identical.
source_and_bytecode_findings.recipes: All recipe class/resource files are byte-identical.
source_and_bytecode_findings.resources: Item models, textures and definitions copied by Polymer are unchanged; only obsolete native GUI sprite resources were removed.

requirements.shim_tiered_backpacks_constraint: 1.0.19 appears only under suggests, which is optional metadata; no Tiered Backpacks depends or breaks constraint blocks 1.0.20.
requirements.native_client_recommendation: Use matching Tiered Backpacks 1.0.20 on server and native client as the runtime-tested target; this audit makes no incompatibility claim about mixed 1.0.19/1.0.20 installations.

fabric_loader_suggests_audit.warning_path: net/fabricmc/loader/impl/discovery/ResultAnalyzer.java:222 gatherWarnings handles only RECOMMENDS and CONFLICTS; SUGGESTS reaches default ignore (lines 231-250).
fabric_loader_suggests_audit.resolution_path: net/fabricmc/loader/impl/discovery/ModSolver.java dependency switches handle DEPENDS, RECOMMENDS and BREAKS, without SUGGESTS constraints; preselected soft mismatches are skipped.
fabric_loader_suggests_audit.conclusion: The existing suggests tiered_backpacks=1.0.19 entry causes neither a hard version block nor a Loader dependency warning when 1.0.20 is installed.

conclusion.limitation: Does not independently certify the revised GUI with arbitrary third-party resource packs; runtime networking/storage checks are separate.
